description: Test helper functions for setting up and managing a webhook monitor in Feishu integration, including port allocation, server readiness checks, and monitor lifecycle management.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Allocates a free TCP port by creating a server, listening on port 0, then closing it and returning the assigned port.

methods.name: waitUntilServerReady
methods.description: Polls the server at the given URL until it responds with a status code between 200 and 499 or times out.

methods.name: buildWebhookConfig
methods.description: Constructs a ClawdbotConfig object with webhook settings based on provided parameters.

methods.name: withRunningWebhookMonitor
methods.description: Attempts to start a webhook monitor with retries, waits until server is ready, runs a provided function, and handles cleanup.
